title: Lakehouse: topology (16 nodes + VIP + ZK roles + Spark master/standby)
description: Runs `nexus topology lakehouse`. Renders the 16 role-annotated nodes, the ZooKeeper leader/follower roles, the Spark ALIVE/STANDBY masters, the iceberg-pg VIP .151 pseudo-node, and the Spark master URL. Not sharded.

observe.what: 16 nodes + the VIP pseudo-node + the spark://...:7077 master URL; ZK shows 1 leader + 2 followers; one Spark master ALIVE leader

whatProves: LakehouseAdapter.TopologyAsync annotates each node with its role, resolves the ZK ensemble roles + the Spark ALIVE leader + the VIP holder, and appends the multi-master spark:// URL; Shards = null (not data-sharded).
